命令式：记步骤。声明式：记终点。: Imperative: record steps. Declarative: record the destination.
每台机器执行顺序与历史不同，: Each machine runs a different order and history;
漂移悄悄发生，没人知道差在哪。: drift happens quietly, nobody knows where.
工具自己算出从现状到终点的路径。: The tool works out the path from here to there.
同一份声明，在任何机器上: The same declaration, on any machine,
命令式的知识活在人的脑子里和聊天记录里；声明式的知识活在仓库里，可以进版本控制、: Imperative knowledge lives in heads and chat logs; declarative knowledge lives in the repository — version-controlled, reviewable, revertible.
